scientific_integrity: Analytic proof uses exact moment identity, a cited symmetric-sextic half-degree theorem, exhaustive multiplicity partitions and exact positive decompositions. A standalone symbolic checker verifies all critical algebraic identities; it is not an independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Real degree-one mean-zero harmonics on the uniform six-point three-subset Johnson slice only; sixth-moment norm ratio and exact Euclidean distortion; does not extend to larger or unequal slices, higher degrees, complex scalars or general p. The quantitative upper stability coefficient is not claimed optimal.
title: Sharp sixth moments and rigidity of the middle six-point Johnson slice
